arabic text: MURJHAAYA HUWA HAI. JUNGLE MEIN KIYON GULSHENAY ZAHRA AEY BADAL.
english translation text: O CLOUD WHY IS ZAHRA’S FLOWER GARDEN WILTING IN THE JUNGLE.

arabic text: PAAMAAL NONIHAALE TAAZAA HAI. HER PHOOL HAY SOOKHA AEY BADAL.
english translation text: O CLOUD HER FRESH FLOWERS HAVE BEEN TRAMPLED AND LEFT PARCHED.

arabic text: WO KERBOBLA MEIN KHAIMAY JALEY,\nSHABBIR KAY BACCHAY ROTEY RAHEY.
english translation text: SHABBIRS CHILDREN ARE CRYING IN BURNING TENTS OF KERBALA

arabic text: DERYA SAY TAU PANI AAYA NAHI.\nAB TU HI BERASJA AEY BAADEL.
english translation text: SINCE WATER DIDN'T COME FROM THE RIVER. WHY DON'T YOU RAIN DOWN SOME WATER OH CLOUD?

arabic text: WOH FAKHERAY SULAIMAN KI BAITI.\nBAY PERDA CHALI HAY BALWEY MEIN.
english translation text: SULAIMAN'S PRIDE, HIS DAUGHTER, IS MADE TO GO BAREHEADED IN PUBLIC.

arabic text: TAAREEK GHATAOUN KO LAA KER TU KER DEY ANDHERA AYE BAADEL.
english translation text: GATHER ALL THE DARK CLOUDS TOGETHER AND MAKE THE DARKEN THE SKIES,\nO CLOUD!

arabic text: SUNTAY HAIN KAY FAUJAY AADA BHI, MUNH PHAIR KAY ROTEE JAATI THI.
english translation text: WE HEAR THAT EVEN THE ENEMIES WERE TURNING THEIR FACE AWAY AND CRYING.

arabic text: DUSHMAN SAY BHI DEKHA JAA NA SAKA ASGHER KA TARAPNA AY BAADEL.
english translation text: EVEN THE ENEMIES COULDN'T SEE ASGHER’S PAIN O CLOUD!

arabic text: ABBAS KO MASHKEEZA DEY KER,\nOUPER JO SAKINA NAY DEKHA.
english translation text: WHILE GIVING THE MASHKIZA TO ABBAS SAKINA LOOKED UP AT YOU.

arabic text: HELKA SA ISHARA BECHHI KA KIYA TU NAY NAA SAMJHA AYE BADEL.
english translation text: YOU COULD NOT UNDERSTAND HER GESTURE AS A PLEA FOR RAIN,\nO CLOUD!
